name: Pesaex
shortDescription: Crypto ↔ Mobile Money bridge for Africa — USDC on/off-ramps and cross-border transfers on Safrochain.
description:
Pesaex (PesaX) is payment infrastructure built on Safrochain — the real-world money on/off ramp for the ecosystem.

It bridges crypto and Mobile Money across Africa, allowing users to convert Mobile Money to USDC (on-ramp), USDC to Mobile Money (off-ramp), and send value across borders (e.g. Kenya ↔ Nigeria) more cheaply and quickly than traditional rails.

Built on Safrochain with USDC from Noble via IBC. Initial focus: Kenya and Nigeria. Goal: make fiat-to-crypto and crypto-to-fiat transfers cheaper, faster, and more accessible.
